games.name: Retro Mechanics [BETA]
games.desc:
Welcome to Retro Mecanica!

This game takes you directly to the past, to the 1970s, in Argentina, where you will experience the mechanics of vehicles in their highest splendor. Buy used cars, restore them, resell them, race with them, visit the race track and break records!

Tracks aren't your thing? The drag strip is waiting for you, with the best racing you'll find!
What you want is high speed? You have the oval track at your disposal, where every lap is pedal to the metal!
Would you rather go quiet? You can simply repair a used car and stroll around the countryside.

games.name: Flood Escape: Classic
games.desc:
Locked in a flooding facility, you and your team must work together to push buttons, find the way out, crack the code and escape before the flood takes you!

Flood Escape Classic started development in September 2011, and is what kickstarted the Flood Escape series.

FEC persisted through many of Roblox's fundamental changes; Mobile Support, Dynamic Lighting, Filtering Enabled and many more.

While the game doesn't get updated often now due to focus on FE2, FEC's continued community and player count shows that the game continues to offer a solid experience for obby enthusiasts.
